collection.title: Renault Fluence 2010 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Renault Fluence 2010 Onwards model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Bayonet arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.

image.alt: Renault Fluence 2010 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
